name: Cascading Phalaenopsis White Orchid
nameZh: 垂瀑白蝴蝶兰手作盆栽
description: Double-stem cascading white Phalaenopsis orchids in handcrafted artisanal ceramic planter with live moss.
descriptionZh: 双株优雅垂瀑白色蝴蝶兰，栽植于手作质感陶瓷花器中，铺垫鲜活苔藓，彰显雅致生活品味。

name: Wild Botanical Meadow Bouquet
description: Vibrant golden sunflowers paired with chamomile daisies, thistle, and fresh silver dollar eucalyptus.
descriptionZh: 灿烂向日葵、小洋甘菊、蓟花与银元尤加利叶交织，呈现自然野性花艺之美。

name: Monstera Deliciosa Living Planter
description: Tropical split-leaf monstera planted in a minimalist textured terrazzo ceramic with drainage saucer.
descriptionZh: 热带大开背龟背竹，搭配简约水磨石质感陶瓷盆与接水盘，净化空气美化居家空间。

name: Olive Branch & Casablanca Lily Vase
nameZh: 橄榄枝与香水百合花瓶
description: Fragrant Casablanca lilies arranged with Tuscan olive branches and eucalyptus in a frosted glass cylinder vase.
descriptionZh: 芬芳卡萨布兰卡百合搭配托斯卡纳橄榄枝及尤加利叶，置于磨砂圆柱玻璃花瓶中。
